component.culprit: Overview payload exceeded the 500-token aggregate ceiling: overview@2 renders 612 tokens (cap: 500). A single-shot KPI aggregate has no item stream, so count-capped pagination is inapplicable; raw string slicing of the aggregate is banned, and the aggregate is refused instead of clipped.
component.remedy: overview@2 refused at the result gate (612 > 500 tokens, exit 3). Ground this turn with scoped queries: capcli sql for domain KPI read views, capcli ping list --pending for open asks, capcli sys doctor for health, capcli run inspect cap://<capability> for session fuel headroom. Durable fix: ship overview@3 with a condensed aggregate under 500 tokens
